entities.name: Herder–farmer conflicts in Nigeria
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary:
Across Nigeria, there are a series of disputes over arable land
between Fulani herders and non-Fulani farmers. The conflicts have been especially prominent in the Middle Belt since the return of democracy in 1999. More recently, they have deteriorated into attacks on farmers by Fulani herders.
